reddit.title: Exciting Updates in Provincia: Multi-Language Support and Improved Placement Feedback
reddit.body: We're thrilled to share our latest devtalk on Provincia! Our build UI now supports ten languages, making it more accessible for players around the world. Plus, we've improved the placement feedback system to clearly indicate why certain placements fail. No more guessing! Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement

steam.title: Provincia Update: New Features and Improvements!
steam.body: We're excited to announce that Provincia now supports ten languages in the build UI, making the game more accessible to players worldwide. Additionally, we've refined the placement feedback system to clearly indicate why certain placements fail. This means a smoother and more enjoyable building experience for everyone. Read more about these updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ten-locales-clearer-placement?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ten-locales-clearer-placement
